tables.name: body_daily
tables.doc: One row per day of body measurements, usually from a watch or phone.

tables.name: workouts
tables.doc: Each workout with its start and end, e.g. from Apple Fitness or a watch. The Time page uses the times; body_daily.workout_min is the daily total. A workout paused along the way can be one row per stretch of moving (the Apple Health importer writes it so), so the minutes are the time spent moving. `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: meals
tables.doc: What you ate, one row per meal or snack, e.g. from a food-logging app that writes to Apple Health. A day with no rows was not logged: it is unknown, never zero calories. A day counts as logged once it has at least two main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner); with fewer it is shown but not averaged. A meal before 4 am counts for the day before; a time of exactly 00:00 is read as a date without a time (what a date-only export gives) and counts for its own day.

tables.name: self_report
tables.doc: How you said you felt, on a 0–5 scale. Optional; pages show a prompt when it is empty.

tables.name: screen_sessions
tables.doc: Foreground app sessions across your devices. Overlaps between devices are allowed; Health AIO counts wall-clock time once, preferring the device order in healthaio.toml (the Time page's devices-at-once card counts each device on its own). `end` must be after `start`.

tables.name: events
tables.doc: Calendar blocks: classes, work shifts, planned training.

tables.name: deadlines
tables.doc: Things due on a date: assignments, exams, milestones.

tables.name: ai_work
tables.doc: Stretches when an AI coding agent was working for you: model calls of one session no more than 5 minutes apart. Several sessions at once each count, like several people working. Only times, counts and model token totals; never what was said. A tool busy for over 5 minutes between two calls is missed, so it is a lower bound.

tables.name: ai_prompts
tables.doc: The instructions you typed to an AI coding agent, counted per minute. Only the time; never the text.
